findings.description: Task 1 (code-writing) lists reviewers code-reviewer, test-reviewer but omits security-auditor from the code-writing default set. Acceptable here — Task 1 is a pure data-model/enum change with no auth, input-handling, or tenant-scoping surface; the security-sensitive work (fail-closed projectId lookup) lives in Task 2 and Task 3, which both include security-auditor. Noting for author awareness only.

summary: Template-compliant. All sections present and filled (Solution, Architecture incl. Shared resources, Decisions, Data Models, Dependencies, Testing Strategy with Feature size L, Agent Verification Plan, Risks table, User-Spec Deviations, Acceptance Criteria, Implementation Tasks). Frontmatter correct (created 2026-06-08, status draft, branch dev, size L). 9 Decisions each with Decision+Rationale+Alternatives, every one tied to a user-spec/AC requirement or marked [TECHNICAL]. 8 tasks (<=15), each with brief scope-level Description (2-4 sentences, WHAT/WHY), valid Skill from catalog, valid Reviewers (all of code-reviewer/security-auditor/test-reviewer exist in .claude/agents). No AC or TDD-anchor leakage into tasks; no buried implementation decisions; no time-based estimates. Audit Wave present (Task 5 Code/code-reviewing, Task 6 Security/security-auditor, Task 7 Test/test-master, all reviewers: none). Final Wave present with Task 8 pre-deploy-qa. Wave-conflict check: FunnelService.java is modified by Task 1 (Wave 1) and Task 2 (Wave 2) sequentially across waves — no conflict. Within Wave 2, Task 2 (FunnelService), Task 3 (Factory/EventService/StepExecutor/Engine), Task 4 (frontend) share no modified files — no parallel conflict. Task 3 reads FunnelService but does not modify it. Dependency ordering correct.
